Migrate passwords from plain text to hashes

Source: R/passwords.R
aa_migrate_plaintext_passwords.Rd

A one-time migration for apps with legacy home-grown authentication, where passwords in the users table are stored in plain text. All values of the password column that are not hashes are replaced with scrypt hashes. Already hashed passwords are skipped, so the function can be run repeatedly.

Usage

aa_migrate_plaintext_passwords(db_path, backup = TRUE, dry_run = FALSE)

Arguments

db_path

Path to the SQLite database file.

backup

TRUE (default) - a copy next to the database named <database>.bak_<date>, a string - your own path for the copy, FALSE - no copy (not recommended).

dry_run

If TRUE, change nothing and only show whose passwords would be migrated.

Value

A list (invisibly): migrated (logins whose passwords were or would be migrated), skipped (logins whose password is already a hash), backup (path to the copy or NA), dry_run.

Details

How it works: before any change a backup copy of the database file is made (if there is something to change and backup is not FALSE), all changes run in a single transaction, and every new hash is verified against the original password before being written. On any error the changes are rolled back. The function never prints passwords.

Run the function while the app is stopped. The backup contains plain-text passwords: delete it after checking (and make sure it is not in synchronized folders or in git). After the migration, logging in with the old passwords still works, because the entered password is verified against the new hash.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("RSQLite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  db <- tempfile(fileext = ".db")
  conn <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db)
  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "CREATE TABLE users (login TEXT, password TEXT, role
  TEXT)")
  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "INSERT INTO users VALUES ('alsey', 'plain-secret',
  'admin')")
  DBI::dbDisconnect(conn)

  # what would be migrated
  aa_migrate_plaintext_passwords(db, dry_run = TRUE)

  # run without a backup (in this example only; keep the backup in real use)
  aa_migrate_plaintext_passwords(db, backup = FALSE)
}
